label: benign
subject: Summer SWE internship
body:
Hello Priya,

My name is [Recruiter Name] and I’m reaching out from Acme Robotics. We currently have summer software internship opportunities available in Austin, offering a rate of $42 per hour. You can find details about the position at https://acmerobotics.com/careers/1234. 

If this role aligns with your interests, I would be happy to schedule a brief, 30-minute introductory conversation sometime next week.

label: benign
subject: Interview scheduling
body: We appreciate your application for the Analyst position. Please let us know when you are available for a video interview lasting approximately 45 minutes, either on Tuesday or Wednesday. The interview will be conducted by myself and our team lead.

label: benign
subject: Application received
body: Your application for the Data Analyst I position has been received. The team is currently reviewing submissions, and we will contact you if your qualifications align with our needs. You are welcome to monitor the status of your application at any time through handshake.com.

label: benign
subject: Quick question about your project
body: Your profile indicated experience with supply-chain simulations, which caught my attention. Our team is launching a new operations rotational program this June. I was wondering if you’d be interested in discussing it – feel free to decline if it’s not a good fit.

subject: Offer details
body: We are pleased to inform you of a job offer for the Clinical Data Coordinator role, with a starting salary of $68,000 per year, in addition to our comprehensive benefits package. You will receive the official offer letter through our HR platform, Workday. Please allow yourself one week to consider this opportunity.

subject: Case study deadline
body: Just a reminder: the take-home case study is due by 5:00 PM Eastern Time on Friday. Please submit your completed case study using the portal link provided in your initial email. If you require additional time, please reach out and we can discuss an extension.

label: benign
subject: Internship: remote option
body: Just to reiterate, the internship position is initially available as a remote opportunity for the first month. Compensation will be $30 per hour, based on a 40-hour weekly schedule, and a laptop will be supplied. The interview process will consist of Zoom meetings with two of our engineers.

subject: You're hired
body: You’ve been chosen to fulfill a remote Data Entry Assistant role with a compensation rate of $45 per hour – an interview is not required. Please connect with our recruitment manager on Telegram at @acme_hr to receive your onboarding materials and proceed further.

label: recruiter_scam
subject: Personal assistant opportunity
body: I am seeking a dependable student for a personal assistant position requiring approximately 10 hours per week, with a pay rate of $800 per week. The tasks involved are straightforward – accepting deliveries and completing various errands. Please send a text message to +1 (404) 555-0199 if you are interested in beginning work this week.

label: recruiter_scam
subject: Interview via Google Chat
body: We are pleased to inform you that your application has been selected for consideration for the Remote Customer Support position, which offers a rate of $38 per hour. The next step in the process is an interview that will take place via Google Chat with the hiring manager. Please add briefing.manager@gmail.com as a contact and reply with the code LH-2291 to initiate the interview.

subject: Equipment for your home office
body: We are pleased to have you join us. Prior to beginning training, please acquire the necessary laptop and software through our designated vendor. A check for $3,450 will be sent to you to facilitate this purchase; kindly deposit it and then submit payment to the vendor using Zelle.

label: recruiter_scam
subject: Confidential role
body: I am an experienced recruiter partnering with a major Fortune 500 company. This position offers a salary of $95,000 and requires no prior experience, however, details are confidential – please refrain from sharing this opportunity with your university. To initiate the background check process, please provide your complete name, date of birth, and residential address.

subject: Job offer - start immediately
body: Following a review of your Handshake profile, we are pleased to offer you the position of remote Payroll Clerk, with an immediate start date. To secure your training materials, a $150 registration fee is necessary. Please submit payment through Cash App and forward a copy of your receipt.

subject: Mystery shopper program
body: Receive payment of up to $500 for each mystery shopping task, with a flexible schedule and the convenience of working remotely. We will provide you with funds to purchase gift cards from a designated retailer, and you will then submit the gift card codes to us.

body: I am a university professor and am seeking a remote research assistant position with a weekly compensation of $400. Payment will be issued in advance via check. Please respond with your personal email address to facilitate further discussion.

body: Congratulations, your chat-based interview was successful. To complete the onboarding process, please submit a photograph of either your passport or driver’s license. Additionally, we require your online banking login details to facilitate payroll setup, and kindly provide these before Friday.

label: recruiter_scam

body: We are currently seeking individuals to join our team as online survey assistants. This position offers a rate of $35 per hour, a flexible schedule, and does not require prior experience. To complete the application process, please contact us via WhatsApp at +1 213 555 0142. Due to high demand, interested candidates are encouraged to apply without delay.
